Title: Users aren't returned results when searching on SharePoint Online sites

User impact: Users aren't returned results when searching on SharePoint Online sites.

More info: Users are returned a blank screen when searching on affected SharePoint Online sites.

Current status: We're reviewing the support case to further our understanding of the current impact scenario and to determine our next troubleshooting steps.

Scope of impact: Your organization is affected by this event, and approximately 400 users aren't returned results and see a blank screen when searching on SharePoint Online sites. This section may be updated as the investigation progresses.
